title: ICOMzero
summary: Direct radio listening, waterfall, CW decoding and FT8 with QSO logging.
description:
Turn your Cardputer Zero into a direct network radio companion. Choose Radio, FT8 or Settings from the icon menu; no computer bridge is needed for the supported network radios.

RADIO — Listen through the speaker with a live spectrum/waterfall. Hold Z/C to tune, select bands and USB/LSB/CW/CW-R modes, and save a 1000/500/100 Hz step per radio. Volume and mute are saved. Noise reduction and antenna-tuner controls are available where supported; starting the tuner briefly transmits.

CW — Receive-only Morse decoding with automatic or manual tone selection, detected pitch and estimated speed. W enables decoding without changing the radio mode, dial or filter. F/X or Fn+F/Fn+X scrolls history; hold to repeat and return to the bottom to follow new text. Up to 16,384 characters stay in memory during a Radio session. Retunes and resynchronization start a new line instead of clearing the history. Crowded signals and irregular sending can still cause errors.

FT8 — Silent reception, Messages with subdued region and signal-strength details, highlighted CQ/POTA/SOTA calls and conversations involving you, offline country/territory estimates and USA state labels. Enter replies to a selected decode or continues its current exchange. Auto audio frequency follows the other station and replies use the opposite UTC period. Standard contacts use RRR and finish with 73. Local TX rows appear after the transmit period.

AUTOMATION — Auto CQ sends one own CQ, then tries up to five fresh strong CQ stations twice each if unanswered. Callers heard during another exchange enter a queue. POTA Hunt monitors POTA/SOTA CQs, starts with a direct R-report and allows three unanswered attempts per stage before resting and monitoring again. Both modes must be started explicitly and stop on faults.

LOGGING — Save completed contacts locally with ADIF data and independently upload to Wavelog and QRZ. Retry pending uploads, review a manual Record QSO entry, and import worked history with Sync Log. Hide previous contacts applies to FT8 on the current band; Auto CQ still answers or queues worked stations addressing you. Green QSO notifications and optional speaker beeps confirm local saves. QRZ API access may require a subscription.

SETTINGS — Name, edit and clone multiple radio profiles. Check GitHub updates at launch or manually, with download progress and SHA-256 verification. Credentials and private diagnostic/session journals remain on the device and are not bundled publicly.

FT8 requires configured station identity, synchronized device time and radio TX permission. Automatic antenna tuning briefly transmits after selecting a band. SWR above 2.0, excessive ALC, stale active-TX telemetry, clock/PTT failures and disconnects stop transmission. Press Enter to request warning clearance; faults do not restart TX automatically. Network-polled protection supplements the radio's protection.

Direct profiles: IC-705, IC-7300MK2, IC-7610, IC-7760, IC-7850/7851, IC-905, IC-9700, IC-R8600 (RX only), and native KNS for TS-890S. IC-7300MK2 is physically tested; other profiles await hardware validation. USB/serial-only radios and the original IC-7300 are outside this direct-network release.
